badge.name: Full Stack Web Development
badge.description: Recognizes completion of both the relational REST API and React client assessments, each at the instructor-reviewed threshold.

criteria.narrative:
Awarded after instructor review confirmed at least 75% on each required activity: M5A4 (Relational REST API) and M5A5 (HAUnted Sightings React client).

Award threshold: 75%.

m5a4: Relational REST API. Built a Node and Express API backed by a relational database. The assessment covered related tables and joins, REST endpoints, input validation, error handling, parameterized queries and separation of routes from data access.

m5a5: HAUnted Sightings React client. Built a React client for the sightings API. The assessment covered API-driven lists and forms, server-side filtering, loading, error and empty states, responsive design, accessibility and component structure.
